notes: All numeric values in this file are EXTRACTED from Python
constants in kb/seismic_detailing.py. Logic remains in Python.
This JSON contains only values (the 'what'), not algorithms.
Schema compatibility is enforced by kb_rules_loader.py.
Any change here should keep the same structure or update the loader.
To verify parity: run tests/test_v06_phase2.py — parity test
ensures old Python constants == new JSON-loaded values.

seismic_zone_factors.description: Z factor per IS 1893:2016 cl. 6.4.2 Table 3. Represents peak ground acceleration as fraction of g.

importance_factors.description: Importance factor I per IS 1893:2016 cl. 6.4.2 Table 8.
importance_factors.notes: Important buildings = schools, hospitals, fire stations, telecom. Residential single/multi-family = standard (1.0).

response_reduction_factors.description: R factor per IS 1893:2016 cl. 7.2.6 Table 9 for RC moment-resisting frames.

is13920_applicability.description: Which seismic zones require IS 13920 ductile detailing.
is13920_applicability.notes: Zone II is exempt for residential, but IS 13920 is still good practice. Important buildings (schools, hospitals) require IS 13920 in ALL zones regardless.

column_minimum_dimensions.notes: 230mm min for non-seismic (normal practice). 300mm min for seismic (IS 13920 cl. 7.1.2). Aspect ratio (b/D) ≥ 0.4 to avoid wall-like behaviour.

column_steel_percentages.description: Longitudinal steel percentage limits per IS 456 cl. 26.5.3.1 + IS 13920.
column_steel_percentages.notes: Below 0.8% = under-reinforced; above 4% = congestion. Zone-wise recommendations increase with seismic demand.

stirrup_spacing.description: Transverse reinforcement spacing per IS 13920 cl. 7.4.

column_special_confining_zone.notes: Over length Lo from joint face (larger of h/6, 450mm, or where Mu > 0.4 Muz). Tighter confinement here.

column_general_zone.notes: In the middle portion, spacing can relax but ≤ half least dim.

beam_near_support.notes: Over 2d from beam face, stirrups at d/4 or 150mm max.

plan_regularity.description: Irregularity classification thresholds per IS 1893:2016 cl. 7.1.

re_entrant_corner.notes: Projection of re-entrant corner as % of overall plan dimension. >15% = irregular (IS 1893). >30% = severely irregular in our practice (2× code limit).

plan_aspect_ratio.notes: L/B ratio. >4 is irregular, >6 structurally risky.

vertical_setback.notes: Vertical geometric irregularity: setback > 25% of dimension below.

slenderness.description: Column slenderness limit per IS 456 cl. 25.1.2.
slenderness.notes: Slenderness ratio (effective length / least lateral dim) must be ≤ 12 for short column. >12 means slender column — additional P-delta moments need engineer analysis.
